name: claude-model-switch
description: A session that booted on one model and switched to another two minutes in — the oracle finding of 2026-07-29. The header must name the CURRENT model, the window must be resolved from it (the fixture switches from a 200k model to a 1M one so a stale header also fails the window), the switch must be disclosed, and the anchor must keep measuring the boot turn.
title: fixture-model-switch

expect.notes: anchor_tokens is input 8 + cache_creation 24000 + cache_read 3000 from the BOOT turn (claude-opus-4-5). The two later claude-opus-4-7 turns are past the head boundary: they move the header's model and window, never the anchor or the inventory.
